quote.en: Idehnegar built our nationwide emergency-management system and has been a multi-year technical partner ever since.

quote.en: Officially certified by the Kermanshah Governorate for building the statistics center site of the Management & Planning Organization.

quote.en: Since 2020 we've partnered with this group and its 11 subsidiaries on websites, online stores, and custom software.

quote.en: Officially certified by the Science & Technology Park for building their website and admission system.
